ei.title: 6번: A Common Bias in Judging Others
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Imagine that you ask a man for directions, and he gives you a rude response. You will probably assume that he has an unpleasant personality. In fact, though, he might have just received some terrible news that has seriously affected his mood. His response may have resulted from these circumstances, not from his true nature. It is quite common to blame someone's personality without considering situational factors that may have contributed to his or her actions. What is especially interesting is that, while we often do this to other people, we rarely do it to ourselves. When looking at our own actions, we always believe that we have good reasons for the things we do. However, we are quick to judge others negatively while ignoring possible contributing factors.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: consider → considering (전치사 without 뒤에는 동명사)
det.analysis:
① gives: 'he gives you a rude response' 3인칭 단수 주어 he + 동사 gives — 적절
② consider: 'without ___ situational factors'에서 전치사 without 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하므로 considering이 맞음 ←정답
③ contributed: 'may have contributed' 조동사 may + have + 과거분사 — 적절
④ ignoring: 'while ignoring possible factors' 분사구문 -ing — 적절
det.tip: 전치사(without, by 등) 뒤 동사는 동명사(-ing). without considering

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
